newsitem.title: USA: Steris starts Isomedix tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Steris starts Isomedix tender offer.

text.p: Steris Corp formally unveiled Monday its $20.50 per share cash tender offer for Isomedix Inc, which is part of a $142 million merger combining two leading U.S. sterilization and infection prevention companies.
The tender offer is set to expire on September 16, 1997, unless extended.
Last Tuesday, the companies announced the friendly transaction, which is not contingent on financing.
Steris's offer was advertised in the Wall Street Journal today.

The merger "expands our ability to serve our current customers while significantly enhancing Steris's access to the scientific and industrial contract sterilization and microbial reduction markets," Steris Chairman Bill Sanford said in a statement.

In a joint statement, the companies said the merger pact was driven partly by consolidation in the healthcare industry, which has "created the need for companies with broader overall products lines and service capabilities."
Steris's $20.50-per-share offer is a premium of more than 30 percent above the average price of Isomedix shares over the 90 days preceding the announcement, they said.
The companies said they expect to close the transaction by the end of September.
In afternoon New York Stock Exchange trade, Isomedix shares were up 1/16 to 20-5/16. Steris shares had slipped 1/2 to 38.
